tools.name: create_issue
tools.description: Create an issue in a GitHub repository. REQUIRES: `Github-Token` (HTTP) or GITHUB_TOKEN with issues write if creating issues in private repos.

labels.description: Label names (must already exist in the repository).

clientName.description: REQUIRED: The name of the client/agent using the MCP server for analytics tracking.

tools.name: create_pr
tools.description: Create a new branch (git ref), one commit from the base tree with your file changes, then open a pull request in the same repository. REQUIRES: `Github-Token` (HTTP) or GITHUB_TOKEN with `contents: write` (and no existing branch with the same `headBranch` name).

headBranch.description: Name of the new branch (must not already exist on the remote).

baseBranch.description: Branch to base the PR on (e.g. main). Defaults to the repo default branch.

commitMessage.description: Single commit message for the file changes.

clientName.description: REQUIRED: The name of the client/agent using the MCP server for analytics tracking.

tools.name: generate_jira_kanban_board
tools.description: Generate a Mermaid kanban board from Jira issues. Issues are grouped into columns by their current status and ordered by workflow stage (To Do → In Progress → Done). Each card shows the issue summary and is a clickable link to the ticket, with optional assignee and priority badges.

projectKey.description: REQUIRED: Jira project key, e.g. 'PROJ' or 'MYTEAM'.

sprint.description: Filter by sprint name or numeric ID, e.g. 'Sprint 12' or '42'.

assignee.description: Filter by assignee — Jira account ID, display name, or 'currentUser()'.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of issues to fetch (1–100, default 50).

clientName.description: REQUIRED: The name of the client/agent using the MCP server for analytics tracking.

tools.name: generate_ticket_dependency_tree
tools.description: Generate a Mermaid flowchart that visualises Jira issue dependency links for a project. Each node shows the ticket key, summary, and status, and is a clickable link to the ticket. Dashed nodes represent issues linked from outside the current filter set.

projectKey.description: REQUIRED: Jira project key, e.g. 'PROJ' or 'MYTEAM'. Used as the base JQL project filter.

status.description: Filter by issue status, e.g. 'In Progress', 'To Do', 'Done'.

assignee.description: Filter by assignee — Jira account ID, display name, or 'currentUser()'.

reporter.description: Filter by reporter — Jira account ID or display name.

sprint.description: Filter by sprint name or numeric ID, e.g. 'Sprint 12' or '42'.

createdAfter.description: Include only issues created on or after this date, ISO format: '2024-01-15'.

createdBefore.description: Include only issues created on or before this date, ISO format: '2024-03-31'.

maxResults.description: Target number of issues to render in the tree (1–100, default 50).

useUrlShortener.description: Shorten the preview/edit URL via Short.io. Disable to get the full unshortened URL (default true).

colorMode.description: Color scheme for the diagram: 'light' (default pastel fills), 'dark' (deep fills for dark backgrounds), or 'none' (no fill/stroke overrides, inherits the Mermaid theme).

clientName.description: REQUIRED: The name of the client/agent using the MCP server for analytics tracking.

tools.name: generate_ticket_diagram
tools.description: Generate a Mermaid flowchart centred on a single Jira ticket. Fetches the ticket's subtasks, parent, issue links, and recent comments in one call. The focal ticket is highlighted in indigo; subtasks are grouped in a subgraph; issue links use colour-coded arrows (red thick = blocks, cyan dashed = relates to); comments appear in a rose subgraph.

ticketKey.description: REQUIRED: Jira issue key, e.g. 'MC-123' or 'PROJ-42'.

colorMode.description: Color scheme for the diagram: 'light' (default pastel fills), 'dark' (deep fills for dark backgrounds), or 'none' (no fill/stroke overrides, inherits the Mermaid theme).

clientName.description: REQUIRED: The name of the client/agent using the MCP server for analytics tracking.

tools.name: generate_ticket_timeline
tools.description:
Generate a Mermaid diagram showing the history of a single Jira ticket using its changelog. Two views are available:
- **state**: stateDiagram-v2 showing all status transitions with dates and authors, nodes coloured by status category.
- **timeline** (default): Mermaid timeline grouped by month, showing status changes, assignee changes, priority changes, sprint moves, and resolutions.

ticketKey.description: REQUIRED: Jira issue key, e.g. 'MC-123' or 'PROJ-42'.

view.description: Diagram view to generate. 'state' shows status transitions; 'timeline' shows all field changes over time.

clientName.description: REQUIRED: The name of the client/agent using the MCP server for analytics tracking.

tools.name: get_diagram_summary
tools.description: Generate a concise summary for a Mermaid diagram based on its content. This tool provides prompts for the LLM to generate a brief summary (2-4 sentences) highlighting the primary flow, key decisions, and outcomes.

diagramContent.description: The Mermaid diagram content/code for which to generate a summary.

contextHint.description: Optional: Context hint to help generate a more accurate summary.

clientName.description: REQUIRED: The name of the client/agent using the MCP server (e.g., 'claude', 'cursor', 'vscode', 'chatgpt', 'copilot') for analytics tracking.

tools.name: get_diagram_title
tools.description: Generate a descriptive title for a Mermaid diagram based on its content. This tool analyzes the diagram structure and content to suggest an appropriate title.

diagramContent.description: The Mermaid diagram content/code for which to generate a title.

diagramType.description: Optional: The type of Mermaid diagram (e.g., 'flowchart', 'sequenceDiagram', 'gantt') for better context in title generation.

currentTitle.description: Optional: The current title of the diagram, if any, for context.

clientName.description: REQUIRED: The name of the client/agent using the MCP server (e.g., 'claude', 'cursor', 'vscode', 'chatgpt', 'copilot') for analytics tracking.

tools.name: get_issue_comments
tools.description: List comments on an issue by issue number. REQUIRES: `Github-Token` (HTTP) or GITHUB_TOKEN / GH_TOKEN.

issue_number.description: Issue number (not a PR number unless the PR is also addressed as an issue on GitHub).

clientName.description: REQUIRED: The name of the client/agent using the MCP server for analytics tracking.

tools.name: get_mermaid_syntax_document
tools.description: Get comprehensive syntax documentation and examples for a specific Mermaid diagram type. Returns the official Mermaid.js documentation with syntax rules, examples, and usage instructions for the requested diagram type.

diagramType.description: The type of Mermaid diagram to get syntax documentation for (e.g., 'flowchart', 'sequenceDiagram', 'architecture-beta', 'gantt', 'gitgraph', 'classDiagram', 'stateDiagram', etc.).

clientName.description: REQUIRED: The name of the client/agent using the MCP server (e.g., 'claude', 'cursor', 'vscode', 'chatgpt', 'copilot') for analytics tracking.

tools.name: get_notion_mermaid_diagram_by_block_id
tools.description: Retrieve a single Mermaid diagram block by its block ID. Returns the diagram code and optional caption.

blockId.description: The Notion block ID of the mermaid code block (e.g. from get_notion_page_mermaid_diagrams).

clientName.description: REQUIRED: The name of the client/agent using the MCP server for analytics tracking.

tools.name: get_notion_page_mermaid_diagrams
tools.description: Extract all Mermaid code blocks from a Notion page. Returns block ID, diagram code, and optional caption for each block.

pageUrl.description: URL of the Notion page (e.g. https://www.notion.so/My-Page-abc123...).

clientName.description: REQUIRED: The name of the client/agent using the MCP server for analytics tracking.

tools.name: get_pull_comments
tools.description: Get all pull request comments: both issue/PR thread comments and inline review comments, with a `type` of `issue_thread` or `review` per item. REQUIRES: `Github-Token` (HTTP) or GITHUB_TOKEN / GH_TOKEN.

clientName.description: REQUIRED: The name of the client/agent using the MCP server for analytics tracking.

tools.name: insert_notion_mermaid_diagram
tools.description: Append a Mermaid diagram as a code block to a Notion page. The block is added at the end of the page content.

pageUrl.description: URL of the Notion page to insert the diagram into.

caption.description: Optional caption displayed below the code block.

clientName.description: REQUIRED: The name of the client/agent using the MCP server for analytics tracking.

tools.name: list_branches
tools.description: List or resolve branch names. **List mode (default):** one `GET /repos/.../branches?per_page=100&page=1` — at most 100 names, A–Z sorted in the response; `has_more` if a full page was returned. **Resolve mode:** set `branch_name` for a single `GET` branch (404 if missing). At most one GitHub API call. REQUIRES: `Github-Token` (HTTP) or GITHUB_TOKEN / GH_TOKEN.

branch_name.description: Exact branch name. When non-empty, returns that branch only. Omit to fetch the first 100 branches only.

clientName.description: REQUIRED: The name of the client/agent using the MCP server for analytics tracking.

tools.name: list_issues
tools.description: List issues for a repository (excludes pull requests). REQUIRES: `Github-Token` (HTTP) or GITHUB_TOKEN / GH_TOKEN.

since.description: ISO 8601: only issues updated at or after this time.

clientName.description: REQUIRED: The name of the client/agent using the MCP server for analytics tracking.

tools.name: list_mermaid_files
tools.description: List .mmd Mermaid files in a GitHub repository (code search with tree fallback). REQUIRES: `Github-Token` header (HTTP) or GITHUB_TOKEN / GH_TOKEN.

ref.description: Optional branch, tag, or commit for tree fallback when code search is unavailable.

clientName.description: REQUIRED: The name of the client/agent using the MCP server for analytics tracking.

tools.name: list_pulls
tools.description: List pull requests for a GitHub repository. REQUIRES: `Github-Token` (HTTP) or GITHUB_TOKEN / GH_TOKEN.

clientName.description: REQUIRED: The name of the client/agent using the MCP server for analytics tracking.

tools.name: list_repos
tools.description: List GitHub repositories for the authenticated user, or for an organization when `org` is set. REQUIRES: `Github-Token` header (HTTP) or `GITHUB_TOKEN` / `GH_TOKEN` in the server environment.

org.description: Optional: organization login. If set, lists that org's repositories; otherwise lists repos for the authenticated user.

type.description: User repo filter; ignored when `org` is set.

clientName.description: REQUIRED: The name of the client/agent using the MCP server for analytics tracking.

tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: Lists all available MCP servers and their tools in the workspace.

clientName.description: OPTIONAL: The name of the client/agent using the MCP server (e.g., 'claude', 'cursor', 'vscode', 'chatgpt', 'copilot') for analytics tracking.

tools.name: push_file
tools.description: Create or update a single file on a given branch in a GitHub repository. REQUIRES: `Github-Token` (HTTP) or GITHUB_TOKEN with contents write access.

sha.description: Existing blob SHA to update; omit to create or to let the service detect.

clientName.description: REQUIRED: The name of the client/agent using the MCP server for analytics tracking.

tools.name: read_mermaid_file
tools.description: Read a single .mmd file from a GitHub repository. Only paths ending in .mmd are allowed. REQUIRES: `Github-Token` header (HTTP) or GITHUB_TOKEN / GH_TOKEN.

path.description: Path to the .mmd file in the repository.

ref.description: Optional: branch, tag, or commit SHA; defaults to the default branch.

clientName.description: REQUIRED: The name of the client/agent using the MCP server for analytics tracking.

tools.name: search_mermaid_icons
tools.description: Search for available Mermaid icons by provider or name. Returns icons in ready-to-use format with provider prefixes (e.g., 'aws:arch-amazon-ec2'). PERFORMANCE TIP: For faster searches, start with limit=10 and specific queries. If no suitable icons found, increase limit and retry. Supports AWS, Azure, GCP, and FontAwesome icon sets.

query.description: Search query for icons (e.g., 'aws', 'azure', 'gcp', 'fa', 'lambda', 's3', 'database'). Use specific terms for better results.

provider.description: Optional: Filter by specific provider ('aws', 'azure', 'gcp', 'fa'). If not provided, searches all providers.

limit.description: Optional: Maximum number of results to return per provider. Defaults to 10 for performance. Increase if needed.

clientName.description: REQUIRED: The name of the client/agent using the MCP server (e.g., 'claude', 'cursor', 'vscode', 'chatgpt', 'copilot') for analytics tracking.

tools.name: update_notion_mermaid_diagram
tools.description: Update the Mermaid source code (and optional caption) of an existing mermaid code block by its block ID.

blockId.description: The Notion block ID of the mermaid code block to update.

caption.description: Optional new caption. Omit to clear the existing caption.

clientName.description: REQUIRED: The name of the client/agent using the MCP server for analytics tracking.

tools.name: validate_and_render_mermaid_diagram
tools.description: SIMPLE RENDER TOOL - Renders Mermaid diagrams directly (Mermaid automatically validates during rendering). If successful, returns diagram image. If Mermaid validation fails, returns error details for fixing. One tool, one call, simple workflow.

prompt.description: A text description of the diagram to generate.

mermaidCode.description: Mermaid code to render. Mermaid validates automatically during rendering - if invalid, tool returns error details for fixing.

clientName.description: REQUIRED: The name of the client/agent using the MCP server (e.g., 'claude', 'cursor', 'vscode', 'chatgpt', 'copilot') for analytics tracking.

useUrlShortener.description: Whether to use URL shortening for the Mermaid link. Defaults to true, set to false to disable shortening.
